D1.rationale: state.json episodes record every action with tool, arguments and result; T2 record complete for the calls made (agent pre-created the directory, so no failure occurred); no per-entry timestamps; no coverage assertion.

D3.rationale: Episode list order only; a history cursor exists but no sequence or timestamps are bound to entries.

D4.rationale: The record is bound to a stable agent identifier (agent_id field of the persisted state) covering all episodes.

D5.rationale: Fixture secret in cleartext x3 in the record; no redaction mechanism found in pinned docs or source.
